name: The Salty Koharu Has a Soft Spot for Me
original_name: 塩対応の佐藤さんが俺にだけ甘い
overview: The coming-of-age romantic comedy depicts the first love between two people — except each one has unrequited love for the other. Sōta Oshio, who works at a café. He learns one day that Koharu Satō, a classmate known as "cold Satō-san," is actually just shy and awkward. From that day forward, the distance between the two quickly narrows…
